title: Generate Parentheses
description:
Given n, generate all valid sequences of n pairs of round brackets.

Example 1:
Input: n = 3
Output: ["((()))","(()())","(())()","()(())","()()()"]

Example 2:
Input: n = 1
Output: ["()"]

Constraints:
- 1 ≤ n ≤ 8
idea: Encode '(' as +1 and ')' as −1: a sequence is valid when every prefix sum is ≥ 0 and the total is 0. That gives backtracking: add an opening bracket while there are fewer than n of them, add a closing bracket only while there are fewer closing than opening ones. Once 2n characters are placed, record the answer.
